description: This file defines classes and methods for handling style errors in code, specifically implementing a style error handler class with methods for error reporting, comparison, and internal state management.

classes.name: DefaultStyleErrorHandler
classes.description: A class that manages style error reporting, including error counting, line filtering, and reporting suppression.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the style error handler with file path, configuration, error count function, and optional line filtering.

methods.name: __eq__
methods.description: Checks equality with another instance based on internal state.

methods.name: _add_reportable_error
methods.description: Increments error count for a category and returns the total.

methods.name: _max_reports
methods.description: Returns maximum allowed reports for a category.

methods.name: should_line_be_checked
methods.description: Determines if a specific line should be checked based on line filtering.

methods.name: turn_off_line_filtering
methods.description: Disables line filtering, so all lines are checked.

methods.name: __call__
methods.description: Handles a style error occurrence, reporting it if conditions are met, and manages suppression after reaching max reports.
